labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks when external contributors may open pull requests; this is Contribution process, answered by CONTRIBUTING.md and AI_POLICY.md.

body:
Pull requests are currently limited to collaborators. Per [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md), please open an issue first that names the broken link and describes the change. Any pull request needs a solution that a maintainer has approved; see [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md) if you use AI tools. A related earlier request is #4029.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
